async def act(page):
    # Search for the product 'Aeon capri' using the search functionality
    search_box = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search by keyword")
    await search_box.fill("Aeon capri")
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click the edit link for 'Aeon capri' - assuming it appears in the table after search
    # Use the link with name containing 'Edit' and 'Aeon capri' based on the pattern in the tree
    edit_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Edit Aeon capri")
    await edit_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to the edit page
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    return "Searched for 'Aeon capri' and navigated to its edit page."
